rules.title: Safety and community rules
rules.intro: Boards and chats are for Directors to coordinate. The same protections apply to everybody, from 14 years up.

items.respect: Respect others: no insults, harassment, hate or discrimination.
items.content: No sexual or violent content, nothing that encourages self-harm.
items.personalData: Do not share personal data: neither yours nor anyone else’s (phone, e-mail, addresses, social profiles).
items.noLinks: No links, advertising, spam or requests for money.
items.stayInGame: Stay in the game: the chat is for emergencies and the alliance, not for meeting people.
items.report: If something makes you uncomfortable, report or block: nobody will know you did.

notes.consequences: Breaking the rules brings a warning, then writing is suspended for 24 hours, then for 7 days, finally the account is suspended. Grave cases skip the steps. Every decision is explained and can be contested.
notes.report: Every message, post, name and description can be reported with one tap. A moderator only reads what is reported or stopped by the automatic filter.
notes.minors: If you are under 18: never say where you live, how old you are or how to reach you outside the game. If someone asks, report it.
notes.contact: To contest a decision or for an urgent problem, write to the address in the legal notice.

rules.required: To write on the board and in the chat you must accept the rules.
